findings: The changed delta exports the existing deepest-workspace mapping, consolidates sorted/deduplicated package mapping for auto-detection and shadow tripwires, exposes workspace discovery, and propagates Crypto requirements.

Quick mode invokes beep:lint and beep:check. Full mode invokes upstream Turbo build closure before beep:audit, then docgen. Audit-plan steps stop after the first nonzero exit. Full mode is not equivalent to quick mode.
Absent scripts return skipped=true, ok=true, no exit code and zero duration. They are neither execution evidence nor qualification; inbox recording filters them out.

Verification reads root/workspace manifests, Git changes and HEAD, launches commands, measures wall-clock duration and captures output. CLI closeout writes package shard outcomes; successful full audit clears prior quick lint/check poison. Those are orchestration and filesystem effects.
Root configuration paths map to no workspace. This mapping does not establish root input coverage; nested workspace mapping and sibling-prefix rejection are tested separately.

tests.limits: Upstream refresh/cache-hit ordering tests use controlled shell stand-ins; they are not real Turbo cache or remote replay evidence.

existingNativeEvidence.scope: Prior actual @beep/repo-cli --quick lint/check pass only; not a full audit.
